City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 10, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.

2.

4A.
Presentation by Author Rachel Brupbacher regarding her book “Miles Minor Kellogg and the Encinitas Boathouses”
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 20, 2021 Regular Meeting, October 27, 2021 Special Meeting/Closed Session, and the October 27, 2021 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-11-10 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants.
2021-11-10 Item 08B Approval of Warrants List
8C.
2020 State Homeland Security Program Grant in the amount of $39,939 for the Purchase of 800 MHz Replacement Radios. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Jimenez
1) Accept $39,939 in federal funds from a 2020 State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) grant awarded to the City of Encinitas for the purchase of 800 MHz radios; and 2) Authorize the Fire Chief, or his designee, to sign and submit the required California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services Fiscal Year 2020 Standard Assurances for Cal OES Federal Non-Disaster Grant Programs (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-11-10 Item 08C FY20 SHSGP ENC Award Acceptance
8D.
Adoption of Ordinance 2021-21 establishing a new speed limit on Via Cantebria. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Barr
Adopt Ordinance 2021-21, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limit on Via Cantebria,” establishing a new speed limit of 25 mph on Via Cantebria between Garden View Road and Town Center Drive (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-11-10 Item 08D Via Cantebria Speed Limit Ordinance Adoption
8E.
Amend the Agreement with University of San Diego for services from the Energy Policy Initiatives Center related to implementation of the City’s Climate Action Plan. Contact Person: Sustainability Manager Najera
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to amend the Agreement for services with the University of San Diego (USD) Energy Policy Initiatives Center (EPIC), in substantial form as attached, to complete Climate Action Plan (CAP)-related building ordinances and adding $20,000, which would increase the Agreement’s not to exceed amount to $167,360 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-11-10 Item 08E USD-EPIC Contract Amendment 3
8F.
Additional funding for the MacKinnon Ave. ADA Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS20D) construction contract. Contact Person: Engineer II Kirk
Authorize an increase of $75,000 to the MacKinnon Ave. ADA Sidewalk Improvements Project (CS20D) construction contract with Tri Group Construction and Development Inc. from $330,042 for a new not-to-exceed amount of $405,042.
2021-11-10 Item 08F MacKinnon Ave ADA Sidewalk Additional Funding CS20D
2021-11-10 Item 08F MacKinnon Ave ADA Sidewalk Additional Funding CS20D - Public Comments
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10.
ACTION ITEMS To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Continued public hearing to consider two timely-filed appeals of the Planning Commission's denial of a Design Review Permit, Density Bonus and Coastal Development Permit for the demolition of existing single-family homes and accessory structures, consolidation of four legal lots into one, and construction of a 277-unit apartment development (236 market-rate and 41 low-income affordable units), including a leasing and amenity space, private outdoor recreation space, signage, grading and landscaping improvements. CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003587-2020, DR-003589-2020 & BADJ-003588-2020; APPLICANT: Encinitas Boulevard Apartments 6.95, LP, Randy Goodson; APPELLANT #1: Randy Goodson; APPELLANT #2: Encinitas Residents for Responsible Development, Daniel Vaughn; LOCATION: 2220, 2228 & 2230 Encinitas Boulevard (APNs: 259-231-28, 30, 31 & 32). Contact Person: Planning Manager Colamussi
Deny both appeals but modify the decision of the Planning Commission and adopt attached draft City Council Resolutions No. 2021-93 and No. 2021-95 (Attachments CC-1 and CC-2 of the agenda report) to deny the Density Bonus, Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit, and approve the Boundary Line Adjustment.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
